name: Progress-39
about: Progress-39 (1988-114A), a crewed vehicle (Progress), launched 1988 Dec 25. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1989 Jan  2), held fixed
docked to S17845; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
